basic_info.description: This modern, two-bedroom, two-bath condominium at The LuXe in Pacific Heights offers modern style and convenience, paired with a prestigious address. Located on the main floor beyond the stylish attended lobby, this condominium offers a gourmet kitchen, with an island ideal for a quick breakfast on the go or for chatting with the chef. The clean, contemporary design of the open living space makes entertaining a breeze, and the adjacent patio offers indoor-outdoor living. The spacious master bedroom has a large closet outfitted by California Closets, while the en-suite bath has a luxurious soaking tub. The second comfortable bedroom has its own dedicated patio. In-unit laundry and one-car parking are additional important amenities. Just minutes from Fort Mason, the Marina Green, and the shops and restaurants of Union and Polk streets. With a WalkScore of 99, this is the ideal city home.
